rapport_notes: Rep got visibly flustered by the surprise overnight-fee objection and never gave a clear, confident explanation; the customer ended the call saying he'd use Einstein 'as a last resort.'
process_discipline_notes: Repeated the overnight-fee/drive-time explanation twice in slightly different words without resolving the customer's actual question (why not book from the Houston branch instead).

evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?

top_strength: Correctly and quickly recalculated the two-day/two-city routing option when the customer asked about booking from the Houston side instead, rather than dismissing the question.
coaching_note: The overnight fee landed as a surprise late in the call and was never framed proactively — introducing it earlier, tied to the 'why' (10-hour max drive/move rule), before the customer feels ambushed by an unexpected $240+ charge, would likely prevent this exact objection.
